localizedValues.name: S2-Pond Area Shelter 3002-G
localizedValues.description:
All VEHICLES will be required to purchase the $10.00 Day Parking Pass at Park Entrance Station Self Registration Area next to Stop Signs or have the 12 month Discover Pass visible on vehicle mirror or on vehicle dash. Those who do not have proper passes will be subject to a $99.00 citation! This shelter sits in the northwest corner of the Picnic Area. It is very bright and in the sun with afternoon shading. Close to our juvenile fishing pond, pond trail and Wetlands Interpretive Trail, horseshoe pit and sand volleyball court this facility is sought by active families seeking fun, sun, solitude, playing games, horseshoes, volleyball and much more. The shelter provides a covered table and an oversize concrete pad with picnic tables, BBQ, a large fire pit for a group marshmellow roast, one 110 outlet and light. Come have an enjoyable time at your Community State Park! Amplified music is not allowed. Visitors must clean up after an event. Park hours are from 8 a.m. to dusk, except as noted above. All Washington State Laws apply at the park. Remember Park roadways are considered state highways. We look forward to your visit.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.

localizedValues.name: S1-Picnic Shelter 3001-D
localizedValues.description:
All VEHICLES will be required to purchase the $10.00 Day Parking Pass at Park Entrance Station Self Registration Area next to Stop Signs or have the 12 month Discover Pass visible on vehicle mirror or on vehicle dash. Those who do not have proper passes will be subject to a $99.00 citation! This is one of the most sought after shelters in the park. This facility has a gated parking lot and fenced area for your convenience. Amenities include: concrete pad with BBQ and 8 mounted picnic tables, large fire pit, domestic hose bib, one 110 outlet, and covered table area. There is a beautiful large grassy area with flowers in the spring and trees and surrounding shrubs showing off their fall colors in the autumn, large grassy area is perfect for recreating. Shelter is very close to the Day Use Area Restrooms. This area is a popular area for weddings, birthday parties and just having a family get together. Amplified music is not allowed. Visitors must clean up after an event. Hours are from 8 a.m. to dusk, unless otherwise noted. All Washington State Laws apply at the park. Remember Park roadways are considered state highways. We look forward to your visit.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.
